big_case.notes: The evidentiary scope of the retaliatory-arrest exception has recurring national civil-rights importance. This particular unpublished, fact-intensive municipal damages case has a substantial preservation obstacle, limiting its significance as a vehicle for a national rule. Denial establishes no new substantive rule.
